task:
MuseScore 3 is already open with the file /home/user/Documents/hymn.mscz. The score is a single-staff melody with 3 measures of quarter notes in C major 4/4 and no lyrics at all.

Add a three-syllable lyric line to the first three notes of the first staff. The three lyric syllables, in order, must be exactly:

  sing
  for
  joy

1. Click the very first note in measure 1 to select it.
2. Press Ctrl+L to enter lyric input mode on that note.
3. Type 'sing' and press the spacebar to advance to the next note.
4. Type 'for' and press the spacebar to advance to the next note.
5. Type 'joy' and press Escape to exit lyric input mode.
6. Save the file with Ctrl+S.

The saved score must contain at least three lyric syllables and each of the words 'sing', 'for', and 'joy' must appear as lyric text. The file must remain at /home/user/Documents/hymn.mscz.

verification.description: Score has at least one lyric syllable

cli_feasibility.translation: Unzip .mscz file, parse XML, find <Note> elements, insert <Lyrics><text>word</text></Lyrics> elements with three words across notes, repackage
cli_feasibility.reason: Adding lyrics is inserting child XML elements into Note elements - straightforward with ElementTree, ~35 lines of Python
